services.label: Silver Peak Services
services.title: Design-Build Services for Major Residential Projects.
services.text: Whole-house builds and rebuilds, additions, DADUs and ADUs, basement remodels, kitchens, bathrooms, exteriors, porches, damage restoration, and carpentry & tiling. One accountable team connects planning, design, permitting, construction, and communication from start to finish.

part2.label: What We Build
part2.heading: Services organized from major projects to detailed finish work.

part1.label: Silver Peak Service
part1.text: Full-home renovations and rebuilds that can include layout changes, ADUs, outdoor spaces, custom storage, and full-property improvements.

part2.label: Silver Peak Service
part2.text: Home additions planned around structure, access, permits, budget, and how the new space connects to the existing home.

part3.label: Silver Peak Service
part3.text: Attached and detached dwelling projects with planning for utilities, privacy, access, zoning, and flexible long-term use.

part4.label: Silver Peak Service
part4.text: Underused lower levels turned into family rooms, guest space, laundry zones, home offices, or basement ADUs.

part5.label: Silver Peak Service
part5.text: Kitchens planned around workflow, storage, lighting, appliance placement, custom cabinetry, and natural light.

part6.label: Silver Peak Service
part6.text: Bathrooms built for comfort, waterproofing, storage, accessibility, durable tile, and long-term daily use.

part7.label: Silver Peak Service
part7.text: Exterior updates that protect the home from weather, improve curb appeal, and repair siding, trim, entries, and transitions.

part8.label: Silver Peak Service
part8.text: Covered porch and entry work that improves access, structure, weather protection, and the home’s first impression.

part9.label: Silver Peak Service
part9.text: Rot, water, and damage repairs handled with careful assessment, structural planning, and clean rebuild work.

part10.label: Silver Peak Service
part10.text: Built-ins, shelving, trim, barn doors, natural wood details, tile, and custom finish work.

part1.label: North Seattle Design-Build
part1.heading: Planning First. Build Second.
part1.text1: Good remodeling starts before construction. Silver Peak reviews layout, materials, access, utilities, permitting needs, and existing site conditions so the project direction is realistic from the start.
part1.text2: This approach supports kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, Seattle DADU and ADU planning, basement remodeling, exterior improvements, and long-term property investment.

part2.label: Project Priorities
part2.heading: Big Projects First. Detail at Every Scale.
